editionLabel: Zoch German web rules (archived 2007; English summary)
firstPlayerRule: Everyone secretly chooses a hand card, and the cards are revealed only after all players have chosen. The rules do not assign a first player or a turn order for this selection phase.
clarifications: Before card selection, one player distributes a random grain to each farm without looking. The rules do not specify who performs this supply task, and it does not confer a first card-playing turn.

With two or three players, everyone starts with six cards and secretly selects two per round. You may not select a poultry card and a fox card of the same color together. Reveal only once everyone has selected.
Dice duels, including rerolls by tied contenders, decide who takes food at a farm. They do not select a starting player.
After feeding is resolved, replenish the farms and draw one replacement card per player, or two with two or three players. The next round uses the same secret-selection and reveal procedure.

Pages 1–2 give five initial cards for four to six players, six for two or three, a random grain helper with no selection criterion, one hidden selected card per player (two with two or three), and reveal after everyone plays. Pages 3–5 describe poultry/fox feeding, negotiations and dice duels. Tied contenders repeat duels; these are feeding resolution, not a first-player tie-break. Page 6 replenishes each farm, retains leftover grain, and gives one replacement card (two for two or three), before the next iteration; left-to-right grain distribution in the final-round condition is not a player-turn direction.
